channel.title: Paksh: Crime & Law
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Five Dead in Apparent Murder-Suicide in Georgia
item.description: Five people were found dead in what is being investigated as a murder-suicide at a home in Georgia. The incident is being treated as an apparent murder-suicide. Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 0 · Right 0.

item.title: Woman tried to stop man before tiger enclosure mauling
item.description: A woman reportedly attempted to prevent a man from entering a tiger enclosure at a zoo before he was mauled to death by a tiger. The incident occurred at the London Zoo. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Man Fatally Stabbed Outside Birmingham Pub Event
item.description: A man died after being stabbed outside a pub in Birmingham where a birthday party was taking place. The incident occurred in front of attendees of the event. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Australia United on Execution Ban, Clashes with Trump Over Streaming
item.description: Australia has united in its rejection of allowing the live-streaming of executions, a stance that has put the nation on a collision course with former US President Donald Trump. The debate over the morality and public display of executions… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Australian Engineer Robert Pether Allowed to Leave Iraq
item.description: Australian engineer Robert Pether has been permitted to leave Iraq after being jailed in 2021. The Australian foreign minister welcomed the Iraqi government's decision to allow his departure from Baghdad. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Police pursuit ends in crash, one hospitalized
item.description: A police pursuit in Perth's southern suburbs concluded with a serious crash, resulting in one elderly man being rushed to the hospital. Another individual is in custody following the incident. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Abramovich Aides Accused of Falsifying Records to Hide Wealth
item.description: Aides of Russian billionaire Roman Abramovich, including staff at the accountancy firm Deloitte Cyprus, allegedly falsified paperwork to disguise his assets and potentially dodge tax, according to leaked records. The records suggest that… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Telangana Man Feared Dead on Russian Frontline; Family Seeks Answers
item.description: A man from Kamareddy, Telangana, is feared dead on the Russian frontline, according to reports. He is identified as Khan, and is among four men from Telangana who were allegedly misled into joining the Russian Army. His family is seeking… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Delhi Violence Erupts Amidst Protests, Authorities Respond
item.description: Violence broke out in Delhi on October 9 and 10, characterized by the use of lathis. The events occurred amidst protests, with reports describing an "eerie calm" following the violence. One outlet characterized the situation as "Violence… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 0 · Right 0.

item.title: Former MLA Atar Singh Bhadana killed in attack at crusher plant
item.description: Former MLA Atar Singh Bhadana was killed in an attack at a crusher plant in Bharatpur, Rajasthan. Reports indicate that 70-80 people attacked the plant. The incident is reportedly linked to a dispute over a mining lease with villagers. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Delhi Police enters Bangla Sahib Gurudwara, detains protesters
item.description: Delhi Police entered the Bangla Sahib Gurudwara and detained protesters who had taken shelter there overnight. The Citzens for Justice and Peace (CJP) organization has urged "Sikh brothers" to join a fight against the government, alleging… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Court Denies UAPA-Accused Travel Abroad for UK Research
item.description: A Delhi court has denied UAPA-accused Natasha Narwal permission to travel to the UK for a research presentation at SOAS University. The Additional Sessions Judge at Karkardooma Courts cited that the right to travel abroad is not absolute… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Former BJP MLA Killed by Villagers Over Stone Crusher Dispute
item.description: Former Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) MLA Bhadana was killed by villagers in Bharatpur, Rajasthan, following a dispute over the restarting of a stone crusher. The incident occurred due to a disagreement related to mining activities. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Sixth POCSO Case Filed Against Granite Baron Veeramani
item.description: A sixth case under the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act has been registered against Veeramani, identified as the chairman of Gem Granites and a granite baron. The case is related to a minor sexual abuse probe. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Thieves Loot Telangana ATM Disguised in Nighties, Using Ambulance
item.description: In Telangana, thieves disguised in nighties and masks reportedly looted an ATM. The suspects arrived in an ambulance, used cutting equipment to damage the machine, and escaped with cash. The incident occurred in Telangana. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Harish Salve Criticizes Opposition's Supreme Court Move
item.description: Senior advocate Harish Salve has criticized the opposition's move to approach the Supreme Court, calling it "utter foolishness." Salve stated that the "India Bloc" is "weaponizing the court" and "using the judiciary." The opposition sought… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Rahul Gandhi to March to Supreme Court Over Election Commissioner Appointment
item.description: Congress leader Rahul Gandhi announced a march to the Supreme Court, stating that the entire country will march today against alleged 'vote theft'. This protest is directed against the appointment of Gyanesh Kumar as an Election… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Houthis Attack Saudi Capital, Raising Regional War Concerns
item.description: The Houthi group launched attacks on Saudi Arabia's capital, Riyadh, targeting King Khalid International Airport. The Saudi-led coalition attributed these attacks to the Houthis. In response to the escalating conflict, several countries… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 5 · Right 1.

item.title: Manipur Violence: Naga Group Demands Return of Severed Head
item.description: A Naga civil society organization has issued a 48-hour ultimatum demanding the return of a severed head following fresh violence in Manipur. A video purportedly showing the victim's head among armed militants wearing camouflage went viral… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Houthi Missile Strike Kills 13 at Riyadh Airport, Including One Indian
item.description: A Houthi missile strike on Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport on Saturday killed 13 people, including one Indian national and one person from Hyderabad. The attack, which injured 11 others, was captured on CCTV showing pilgrims… Coverage: Left 4 · Centre 13 · Right 3.

item.title: SFI Alleges Women Activists Detained After Sunset in Delhi
item.description: The Students' Federation of India (SFI) has alleged that 22 of its women activists were manhandled and detained after sunset during a Tiranga rally in Delhi. According to the SFI, the activists were carried away in a bus that did not have… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Car and Bus Collide in Jodhpur, Driver Critically Injured
item.description: In Jodhpur, a car and a bus collided, resulting in the car driver sustaining critical injuries. The driver was admitted to the hospital following the incident, which reportedly occurred during an overtaking maneuver. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 2.

item.title: Christa Pike returns to prison after botched execution and hospital stay
item.description: Christa Pike, who survived a botched execution attempt, has been discharged from the hospital and returned to a Tennessee prison. She was reportedly "angry" over the execution not being completed and had been "ready to die." Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: UK Mayor Condemns US Firing Squad Execution Livestream Plan
item.description: Andy Burnham, Mayor of Greater Manchester, has described the planned livestream of a firing squad execution in the United States as 'abhorrent'. His comments were made in response to the US moving forward with the execution, a plan… Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 0 · Right 0.

item.title: Men allege torture at UP BJP MLA's residence over missing gold
item.description: Three men have alleged they were tortured at the residence of a Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) MLA in Moradabad, Uttar Pradesh. The alleged torture included being hung upside down and given electric shocks. The men claim the mistreatment… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: ASI Shot Dead in Tarn Taran; Fifth Attack on Punjab Cops This Year
item.description: An Assistant Sub-Inspector (ASI) was shot dead in Tarn Taran, Punjab, by assailants on a motorcycle. This marks the fifth targeted attack on Punjab police personnel this year. Following the incident, a high alert was declared in the Tarn… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 5.

item.title: CJI Surya Kant Refuses Meeting with INDIA Bloc Leaders
item.description: Chief Justice of India (CJI) Surya Kant declined a meeting request from leaders of the INDIA bloc. The leaders, including Rahul Gandhi and Mallikarjun Kharge, had sought the meeting to discuss alleged electoral irregularities. CJI Surya… Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 13 · Right 5.

item.title: AAP Leaders Booked Over Gurdwara Bangla Sahib Incident
item.description: Delhi Chief Minister Arvind Kejriwal and other Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) leaders have been booked following a complaint by the Delhi Sikh Gurdwara Management Committee (DSGMC) regarding a 'ruckus' at Gurdwara Bangla Sahib. The AAP has… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Supreme Court hears contempt pleas over Delhi protest clampdown
item.description: The Supreme Court indicated it sees grounds for contempt proceedings in a plea concerning actions taken during Delhi protests. The court issued a notice to authorities after finding a 'prima facie case' in the contempt plea related to the… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 6 · Right 2.

item.title: India Condemns Hormuz Vessel Attacks, Two Indian Seafarers Missing
item.description: Two commercial vessels carrying Indian seafarers were attacked in the Strait of Hormuz and Oman. India has condemned the strikes, with the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) calling for an end to such attacks and de-escalation. Two Indian… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 5 · Right 2.

item.title: Three Killed in Kochi After Mini Cooper Rams Scooter
item.description: Three 21-year-old individuals, identified as Devika, Gopika, and Ijaz, were killed when a Mini Cooper car collided with their scooter near Kochi airport in Ernakulam district. The deceased were part-time salespersons returning to duty. The… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 7 · Right 2.

item.title: Paramilitary drone strike in Sudan kills 41, rights group reports
item.description: A drone strike attributed to Sudan's paramilitary forces has killed 41 displaced people near the Ethiopian border, according to a rights group. Eight children were reportedly among the victims. The strike targeted a gathering of displaced… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Dozens of gold miners killed in airstrikes on Sudan-Egypt border
item.description: At least 72 people were killed and 28 injured in airstrikes on an artisanal gold mining camp in a disputed border area between Sudan and Egypt on Saturday. The Sudan Doctors Network and the Emergency Lawyers organization reported the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 6 · Right 1.

item.title: North Korea Fires Multiple Ballistic Missiles into Sea of Japan
item.description: North Korea launched several ballistic missiles into the Sea of Japan, according to South Korea's military. This action follows a recent hypersonic missile test by South Korea and is part of a continuing series of weapons tests by North… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 9 · Right 1.

item.title: Trump to decide on livestreaming Fort Hood shooter's execution
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump has stated he will decide whether to livestream the execution of Nidal Hasan, the Fort Hood shooter. Hasan was convicted of killing 13 people and wounding 32 others in a 2009 shooting at Fort Hood, Texas. The… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 5 · Right 0.

item.title: Melbourne Man Denies Links to Suspected Hijacker
item.description: A Melbourne man, identified as Samir Mohtadi and also known as Abu Hamza, who leads an Islamic centre allegedly linked to the accused Flydubai hijacker, has released a video. In the video, Mohtadi refers to Islamic texts on the virtues of… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Suspected Plague Case in Russia Linked to Secrecy
item.description: A suspected plague case has emerged in Russia, drawing attention to the country's inherited culture of secrecy from the Soviet era. The incident has prompted questions about what occurred within Russia's plague laboratories. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Three men convicted of murdering surfers in Mexico
item.description: Three men have been found guilty of murdering Australian brothers and an American friend during a surfing trip in Mexico. A Mexican judge handed down the sentences for the crime. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: Singer Ella Langley Cancels Concert Amid Bomb Threat
item.description: Singer Ella Langley canceled a concert due to a bomb threat, stating the event was "not worth a human life." The threat was described as a serious security concern. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Hamilton Police Officer Faces Breach of Court Order Charge
item.description: A veteran Hamilton police officer has been charged with breaching a court order. The charge relates to a historical domestic incident. The officer's name has not been released. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.
